items.title: 68429_Walter P. Thomas oral history interview
items.q: Look at all the clarinet players. Simeon, Buster Bailey...

ctx.x: And he used to copy all of Louis' solos. He could play 'em note for note. But he was just from New Orleans, and that beat was in him. Later on, I found out Fats Domino had that same thing. He had all them guys in New Orleans, he... Look at all the clarinet players. Simeon, Buster Bailey... [BUSTER BAILEY WAS FROM MEMPHIS]
Jimmie Noone. Don't forget Jimmie Noone.
